criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Find Content
categories.definition: User wants to locate or retrieve information about a specific piece of media or information, such as a book, movie, game, song, album, or image.

categories.name: Play Media
categories.definition: User wants to initiate the playback of audio or video content, including songs, albums, artists, playlists, or specific media types.

categories.name: Add to Playlist
categories.definition: User wants to add a specific item, such as a song, artist, or album, to a designated playlist.

categories.name: Rate Content
categories.definition: User wants to assign a rating or express an opinion about a piece of content, such as a book, movie, album, or essay.

categories.name: Book Restaurant Reservation
categories.definition: User wants to reserve a table or make a booking at an eating establishment like a restaurant, cafe, pub, or diner.

categories.name: Get Weather Information
categories.definition: User wants to retrieve current or forecasted weather conditions for a specific location.

categories.name: Find Movie Showtimes & Locations
categories.definition: User wants to find out what movies are playing, where they are playing, and at what specific times.

categories.name: Navigate to Location
categories.definition: User wants to find directions or plan a route to a specific geographical place or point of interest.

categories.name: Find Business
categories.definition: User wants to locate a specific type of business or point of interest, without the intent to make a reservation.
